versions.guide:
Find the pumpkin

A suitable pumpkin can be found in one of the fields near the Hadagan fortress.

Collect the pumpkin

The pumpkin suitable for the stew is the only ripe one in the field. You cannot mistake it for the others.

Find the mushrooms

The poison must not act immediately, or too few guards will be affected. Suitable mushrooms grow only by the river south of Radu's tent.

Gather the mushrooms

The mushrooms are poisonous only when eaten; gathering them is safe.

Mushroom Stew

Storming the Hadagan fortress will be much easier if the enemy soldiers eat something that leaves them unfit to fight. Uncle Radu needs a large pumpkin and poisonous mushrooms for his “relaxing” stew.
